key_points: $949 million fraud verdict forces CVS to divest a business, creating a material negative impact.
Potential CVS coverage boost for Eli Lilly's Zepbound weight-loss drug could drive incremental sales.
CVS' GLP-1 shelf strategy is paying off, benefiting from weight-loss drug side-effect demand.
Aetna (CVS unit) acquires stake in Arizona Medicaid plan from Ascension, adding profitable dual-eligible members.
Q2 earnings review shows CVS outperforming peers in the health insurance provider group.
